log_food.description: Log a food and its calories for a person (who). Answers {id, food, calories}.

today.description: The caller's own entries since a time (ms; by default the last day), and their total: {entries, total}.

forget.description: Delete one of the caller's own entries, by its id. Answers its {id}.

heard.description: The ask channel's trigger: a model reads what someone said they ate, each item is logged as theirs, and they are answered on replies.

summarize.description: The caller's day of eating in one sentence, also posted on replies: {text}.

meta.title: Calories
meta.description: Say what you ate in plain words: a model reads it, logs each item, and your day adds up live.
